newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African stocks bounce firmer on futures, rand.
newsitem.headline: S.African stocks bounce firmer on futures, rand.

text.p: South African shares bounced to firmer levels on Tuesday afternoon, finishing in positive territory for first time in nine sessions.
Dealers said industrial stocks whipped around from early morning weaker levels after lunch when futures traders began to aggressively cover positions in the spot market.
They said a stronger rand -- which put on 2-1/2 cents to finish at 4.6785/6835 on the dollar -- also gave shares a welcome boost.
The industrial index ended 38.3 points firmer at 7,930.2 boosting the all-share index 29.4 pts to 6,762.1.

Gold shares took heart from an improved bullion price, which clung to the $382 level, helping to inject better sentiment into the whole of the market. The index added 22.4 points or 1.3 percent to 1,701.6.
